rule.description: Exact rule for one containing collection space. The application also checks identical space identity, original UTF-8 bytes <=64KiB, duplicate keys, scalar escapes and field byte budgets.

bearerAuth.description: Scoped Bearer identity. Human-only routes reject Agent bearer; action routes enforce their registered grant action.

sessionAuth.description: Production session cookie; development uses db_session. Mutations require CSRF validation.

Exclusive upper bound (RFC3339Nano instant). Must follow the supplied lower bound.
Sort by started_at instant descending, then invocation_id ascending. Omit for legacy ID ascending order. Changing order invalidates cursors.
